Multi-vendor grocery/quick-commerce backend — Admin, Vendor, Customer, Picker and Delivery APIs.

**Auth**: Admin/Vendor use email+password (`/auth/login`); Customer/Picker/Delivery use mobile+OTP (`/auth/send-otp` then `/auth/verify-otp`).
